newsitem.title: USA: CME Sept S&P 500 futures fall more,off 15 pt limit.
newsitem.headline: CME Sept S&P 500 futures fall more,off 15 pt limit.

text.p: September Standard & Poor's 500 futures traded at the Chicago Mercantile Exchange fell further and briefly hit the initial 15.00-point downside price limit in early Friday trading.
The contract fell to 913.05, down 15.00 points, after it had fallen the seven-point opening limit during the first 10 minutes of pit trading.
The next limit restricting price declines is down 30.00 points. That limit would be in effect for 15 minutes or until 1430 CDT/1930 GMT.
